summary: The single public origin routes account/auth APIs to the API Worker, rejects other API paths and serves the SPA for non-API URLs.
transport: HTTPS origin https://axo.leostera.dev; Worker Static Assets uses SPA not-found handling and runs Worker first for /api and /api/*.
framing: Request path routing only. /api/auth and descendants, /api/v1/account/*, /api/v1/accounts/* and /api/v1/host-pairings/redeem delegate to the API Worker. Other /api and /api/* paths return private no-store 503. Non-API paths go to static assets/SPA fallback.

messages.name: GET / and /app
messages.summary: Serve the React app assets; browser pathname selects landing or app UI.

messages.name: /api/auth/* and account-scoped routes
messages.summary: Delegate to the API Worker for OAuth/session and account-authenticated account host/pairing/history APIs.

messages.name: other /api/*
messages.summary: Fail closed with 503 and Cache-Control: private, no-store.
